WITH patient_avgs AS (
  SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) as patient_avg_hgb
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ID
),
overall_avg_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(patient_avg_hgb) as overall_avg
  FROM patient_avgs
),
kept_patients AS (
  SELECT pa.ID, pa.patient_avg_hgb
  FROM patient_avgs pa, overall_avg_calc oa
  WHERE pa.patient_avg_hgb > oa.overall_avg
),
kept_patients_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(patient_avg_hgb) as kept_avg
  FROM kept_patients
)
SELECT 
  kp.ID,
  kp.patient_avg_hgb,
  kp.patient_avg_hgb - oa.overall_avg,
  kp.patient_avg_hgb - kpm.kept_avg
FROM kept_patients kp, overall_avg_calc oa, kept_patients_mean kpm
ORDER BY kp.patient_avg_hgb - kpm.kept_avg DESC
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Patients with no HGB records are excluded entirely (they do not contribute to the per-patient average step, and thus do not affect the overall average).
